test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 26 Sept 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Three statements are given followed by two conclusions numbered I and II. You have to take the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts and decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

Some Trees are Bushes.

All Bushes are Leaves.

Some Leaves are Green.

**Conclusions:**

(I) Some Bushes are Green.

(II) Some Trees are Leaves.
solution:
Given Statements:

Some Trees are Bushes.

All Bushes are Leaves.

Some Leaves are Green.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d2a91443915b18d37c98e6a2c18a32925096f7989e8b0f045b296840489bfbb7.png] 

Conclusions:

(I) Some Bushes are Green → False (No direct relationship given between Bushes and Green, so it may be possible but not defined)

(II) Some Trees are Leaves → **True** (Because Some Trees are Bushes and All Bushes are Leaves, so definitely Some Trees are Leaves.)

Hence, “Only conclusion II follows".
